findings.detail: NFR-F1-6-named-validation-messages has no covering test. No item in the test list asserts that a filing request with an invalid field returns an API response body that names the offending field. T11 asserts the service rejects a negative quantity before any repository call but does not verify the HTTP response carries a field-named message. A behavior test (kind: behavior) is needed that posts an invalid filing payload and asserts the response body contains a message identifying the specific failing field, exercised at the API boundary.
